search_verification.method: Retain the independently reconciled pinned complete same-day inventory and add a final complete overlapping closure-date check.

baseline_full_search.method: Fresh complete identity enumeration of the entire public authored upstream merged-PR search, split into four disjoint creation-date ranges so every partition stays below GitHub's 1,000-result cap. All 20 pages were collected. The 1,728 search identities match the preceding inventory exactly except three known search omissions, individually revalidated via pull-request GET, and four historically verified unavailable ONNX Runtime PRs.
baseline_full_search.search_merge_sha_note: Issue-search responses provide merged timestamps, not merge SHAs. Each enumerated identity's recorded merge SHA is retained from the pinned baseline unless explicitly verified by a fresh direct check.

supplemental_check.reason: An optional, redundant closure-window cross-check was rate-limited after successful full primary enumeration. No further request was made; this does not affect the complete four-partition result.

final_overlap.note: Final overlapping UTC closure-date search from 2026-11-27; full single page. All merged identities compared against the complete 1,735-PR inventory independently reconciled with the current pinned r4 evidence. Merge dates are displayed in Asia/Shanghai to the day only.

ranking_verification.method: Preserve the concurrent same-day full official graph verification; 24 independently rechecked positions and graph commit counts agree. Graph-rendering failures for later checks do not replace latest prior observations.
